text: 7月23日，商务部外国投资管理司司长孟华婷在国新办新闻发布会上表示，商务部将落实好鼓励外商投资产业目录，引导外商投资有机高分子材料、高效节能磁悬浮动力设备等先进制造业，人形机器人研发、现代高端航运服务等现代服务业，鼓励外资更多投向中西部和东北等地区。
text_en: On July 23, Meng Huating, Director of the Foreign Investment Administration Department of the Ministry of Commerce, said at a press conference that the Ministry of Commerce will implement the catalog of encouraged industries for foreign investment, guiding foreign investment into advanced manufacturing such as organic polymer materials and high-efficiency energy-saving maglev power equipment, modern services such as humanoid robot R&D and modern high-end shipping services, and encouraging more foreign investment in central, western, and northeastern regions.
